szoveg_eredeti:
Andy Kelly is coming to ElevenLabs Summit NYC.

Andy is EVP of Global Brand Partnerships at iHeartMedia , where he leads the company’s international expansion and global monetization strategy. He also oversees Ruby by iHeartMedia , iHeart’s branded content studio, whose award-winning campaigns span brands including HBO, IBM, Intel, Amazon, and Chase.

On November 11, Andy joins Dustin Myers of FOX Sports and Alex George , Localization Lead at ElevenLabs, for an ElevenProductions conversation on bringing AI into production and taking content to audiences around the world.

They join Jensen Huang of NVIDIA and Eric Glyman of Ramp on the lineup in New York City.
